benchmark: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M gfx1151 GGUF prefill: 512-row linear/MoE chunk override (geometry-keyed) retained
verdict: retained: 512-row linear/MoE prefill chunks for H2048-MoE geometry on gfx1151 (~1.2% @2048 / ~2.3% @4096 prefill win, chunk-boundary exact); 27B H5120 left on 1024 (inconclusive)
hardware: HP ZBook Ultra G1a, Radeon 8060S / gfx1151, ROCm 7.15.0 pinned, 32 GiB MALL, 40 CU / 20 WGP, 2 MiB L2, ~221 GB/s, 60 W power-limited
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_M (H2048 MoE, 40 layers = 30 GDN + 10 full-attn); Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M (H5120 dense) used for robustness
command: uv run python scripts/pn3_chunksize_sweep.py; uv run python scripts/pn3_chunk_robustness.py; uv run python scripts/pn3_chunkprofile_ab.py

protocol.session: Qwen35GGUFResidentSession(..., prefill_config=PrefillConfig(linear_chunk_size=X, moe_chunk_size=X), prefill L bulk, warmup + timed)
protocol.measure: whole-prefill wall, median of 2 iters per chunk size (128/256/512/1024) at 2048 tok on 35B; 512 vs 1024 at 4096 tok on 35B and 2048 tok on 27B
protocol.correctness: KL(logits 1024-chunk || 256-chunk) = 0.00013 at 2048 tok, top-1 9707 == 9707 (chunk-boundary change is effectively exact; far below 0.034 run-noise floor)

change.policy: _gguf_prefill_chunk_sizes_for(backend, weights) applied after resolve_prefill_config_for_sequence in the GGUF session init; geometry-keyed via _gguf_policy_identity
change.exactness: same kernels, different chunk boundaries; short prompts (<512) unaffected (chunk = min(tokens, 512) = tokens); GDN prefill chunking is effectively exact across boundaries (KL 0.00013)

context.finding: gfx1151 was already 47/56 GGUF-path capability knobs overridden; the gfx1151 _ARCH_CHUNK_PROFILES (linear/moe 256) exists for PARO but the GGUF runner never passes target_arch, so GGUF prefill used the generic 1024/4096 chunks. Sweep showed 512 is the GGUF optimum (the PARO 256 is only -0.2%).
context.inherited_gfx1100_tables: 5 tables inherit gfx1100 defaults (DENSE_PREFILL_SCRATCH_LIVENESS, Q4_T16_UNEQUAL_PAIR, T16_F16_ROCBLAS_*); mostly 27B H5120 memory/prefill-variant policies, low value, not changed here.
context.deferred_to_P3_FULLATTN: hard-coded threads=256 launch geometry in shared .hip (paged_attn_decode, cast, gather, conv, group_scatter) — shared with gfx1100, needs .hip changes

reason: Measured, correctness-neutral (KL 0.00013), config-level win for long-prompt (>1K) prefill on the 35B-A3B gfx1151 lane: 512-row linear/MoE chunks reduce transient scratch and improve pipelining on the 40-CU APU. Gated to the proven H2048-MoE geometry; the 27B H5120 is left on default because its benefit is inconclusive within 60W-lane variance. Benchmark suites (mtpbench 56-214 tok) are unaffected (chunking only applies >1K).
